description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Cassandra as a clustering provider in Orleans. It provides various overloads of `UseCassandraClustering` for both client and silo builders, allowing configuration via services, options, connection string, or session provider delegate.

classes.name: CassandraMembershipHostingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to integrate Cassandra clustering into Orleans by configuring client and silo builders.

methods.name: UseCassandraClustering (IClientBuilder)
methods.description: Configures Orleans client builder to use Cassandra clustering with default settings.

methods.name: UseCassandraClustering (IClientBuilder, Func<IServiceProvider, Task<ISession>>)
methods.description: Configures Orleans client builder to use Cassandra clustering with a custom session provider delegate.

methods.name: UseCassandraClustering (IClientBuilder, Action<CassandraClusteringOptions>)
methods.description: Configures Orleans client builder to use Cassandra clustering with custom options.

methods.name: UseCassandraClustering (IClientBuilder, string, string)
methods.description: Configures Orleans client builder to use Cassandra clustering with connection string and optional keyspace.

methods.description: Configures Orleans silo builder to use Cassandra clustering with a custom session provider delegate.

methods.description: Configures Orleans silo builder to use Cassandra clustering with custom options.
